findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_media_buy_delivery" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: adcp_version, account, media_buy_ids, status_filter, start_date, end_date, include_package_daily_breakdown, time_granularity, include_window_breakdown, attribution_window, reporting_dimensions, context, ext, seatId, seatName

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "prompt:work_with_yahoo_creatives" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Resolve the correct Yahoo advertiser, campaign, or creative identifier before using LeanrIQ Yahoo creative tools.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
